english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something logically sound, sensible, or not absurd.
This is the all-purpose choice for something fair, justifiable, within limits, or fairly priced.
Use 合理 as the all-purpose choice for something that seems valid, acceptable, or likely.
Use this when “logical” means reasonable or acceptable rather than strictly following formal logic.
Use 合理 for reasoning, standards, or methods that are valid and make sense rather than for legal status.
This is the all-purpose choice for an answer, argument, or decision that is well-founded or justifiable.
